corrected_interpretation.issue: All generated kv-runtime role JSON and head-screen-check repeat physical_store_dtype=torch.uint8 based on an unconditional source-derived string in frozen check-kv-runtime.py. That description is incorrect for this BF16 run. The evidence in the same records and raw role logs establishes logical allocated dtype torch.bfloat16. Pinned SGLang memory-pool behavior uses logical dtype for non-FP8 allocations; uint8 backing applies to FP8 logical cache allocations. Therefore the BF16 control physical storage dtype should be reported as torch.bfloat16. Preserve frozen raw JSON and submitted payload unchanged; this is an erroneous descriptor, not a failure of the actual BF16 allocation evidence or head gate. Correct future derived checker to condition physical store dtype on logical dtype and revalidate source behavior.
